text: Beneath it, the bishop is waving goodbye to the inhabitants.

speaker: Inhabitant
content: Uh... Ughh...

speaker: Bishop
content: Slowly. Careful not to trip.

raw: [name="Bishop"]Did you hear that? The sound of the waves. Thump, thump, thump, just like our heartbeats.
speaker: Bishop
content: Did you hear that? The sound of the waves. Thump, thump, thump, just like our heartbeats.

raw: [name="Bishop"]The food you eat and the water you drink are all gifts from the sea. My brothers and sisters, do you feel the energy in you surging throughout your body and on to your heart?
speaker: Bishop
content: The food you eat and the water you drink are all gifts from the sea. My brothers and sisters, do you feel the energy in you surging throughout your body and on to your heart?

raw: [name="Bishop"]Embrace the vastness before you! This is your hope for rebirth!
speaker: Bishop
content: Embrace the vastness before you! This is your hope for rebirth!

raw: [Subtitle(text="Skadi looks at the people onshore.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Skadi looks at the people onshore.

raw: [Subtitle(text="The crowd has started to disperse. The girl has picked a basket full of seafood. At last, she looks up from the ground and begins to search for someone on the empty shore.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The crowd has started to disperse. The girl has picked a basket full of seafood. At last, she looks up from the ground and begins to search for someone on the empty shore.

speaker: Anita
content: Huh? Where's the singer?

raw: [name="Anita"]I took my eyes off her for just a moment, and she disappeared again.
speaker: Anita
content: I took my eyes off her for just a moment, and she disappeared again.

speaker: Anita
content: *Sigh*.

raw: [name="Anita"]Oh well, she knows the way back. She's probably looking for her friend again.
speaker: Anita
content: Oh well, she knows the way back. She's probably looking for her friend again.

raw: [name="Anita"]Let's go, Bench. Let's bring the food back.
speaker: Anita
content: Let's go, Bench. Let's bring the food back.

speaker: Young Inhabitant
content: Uhh...

raw: [name="Anita"]Bench, I want to sing. Let's sing together.
speaker: Anita
content: Bench, I want to sing. Let's sing together.

raw: [name="Anita"]Do you remember the song that the singer sang? It's okay if you don't. I mean, you don't know how to talk. How about I sing it for you?
speaker: Anita
content: Do you remember the song that the singer sang? It's okay if you don't. I mean, you don't know how to talk. How about I sing it for you?

speaker: Anita
content: With homeland left a mile behind♪

speaker: Young Inhabitant
content: Yea...

speaker: Anita
content: His path lies ahead♪

speaker: Young Inhabitant
content: Ahh...

raw: [name="Anita"]Why are you stopping me? *Sigh*. You think it's terrible, don't you? I think so, too.
speaker: Anita
content: Why are you stopping me? *Sigh*. You think it's terrible, don't you? I think so, too.

raw: [name="Anita"]Of course I can't sing as well as the singer!
speaker: Anita
content: Of course I can't sing as well as the singer!

raw: [name="Anita"]But if I keep at it, I will get better, right?
speaker: Anita
content: But if I keep at it, I will get better, right?

speaker: Anita
content: Hehe... His path lies ahead...

raw: [name="Gladiia"]I need to go now. If I don't get going, he will be suspicious.
speaker: Gladiia
content: I need to go now. If I don't get going, he will be suspicious.

speaker: Skadi
content: Captain! What are you planning?

raw: [name="Skadi"]Is it a teammate you're looking for? Why didn't you say so?
speaker: Skadi
content: Is it a teammate you're looking for? Why didn't you say so?

raw: [name="Skadi"]Or is it an enemy you want? If you were my enemy, you would've killed me when I tried to kill you with the seashell just now.
speaker: Skadi
content: Or is it an enemy you want? If you were my enemy, you would've killed me when I tried to kill you with the seashell just now.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Gladiia shakes her head.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Gladiia shakes her head.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]You need to understand what it is that you want first. A hesitant hunter can't spot traps and will only find herself the prey of others. Is that what you want?
speaker: Gladiia
content: You need to understand what it is that you want first. A hesitant hunter can't spot traps and will only find herself the prey of others. Is that what you want?

raw: [name="Anita"]Singer, your eyes seem a little different.
speaker: Anita
content: Singer, your eyes seem a little different.

speaker: Skadi
content: Hm?

raw: [name="Anita"]When you looked at us before, it felt no different from when you looked at the monsters from the sea.
speaker: Anita
content: When you looked at us before, it felt no different from when you looked at the monsters from the sea.

raw: [name="Anita"]But now you are willing to teach me how to make seaweed alcohol, and you sing for us.
speaker: Anita
content: But now you are willing to teach me how to make seaweed alcohol, and you sing for us.

raw: [name="Skadi"]Of course you are different from the monsters.
speaker: Skadi
content: Of course you are different from the monsters.

raw: [name="Skadi"]Monsters wouldn't keep pestering me to sing for them. Monsters can't even speak. Most of the time, they are dirty and dumb, and they know nothing other than to eat.
speaker: Skadi
content: Monsters wouldn't keep pestering me to sing for them. Monsters can't even speak. Most of the time, they are dirty and dumb, and they know nothing other than to eat.

raw: [name="Anita"]S-So... will those monsters from the sea eat us?
speaker: Anita
content: S-So... will those monsters from the sea eat us?

speaker: Skadi
content: If they are hungry, they will.

raw: [name="Anita"]So they come ashore for the same reason we go out to the sea. They are looking for things to eat.
speaker: Anita
content: So they come ashore for the same reason we go out to the sea. They are looking for things to eat.

speaker: Skadi
content: Are you sympathizing with them?

speaker: Anita
content: Going hungry is tough.

raw: [name="Skadi"]I don't think that's how the ones who get eaten see it.
speaker: Skadi
content: I don't think that's how the ones who get eaten see it.

raw: [name="Anita"]Right... I don't want to be eaten by the monsters like this either.
speaker: Anita
content: Right... I don't want to be eaten by the monsters like this either.

raw: [name="Anita"]I've never thought about it before, but now... Uh, I want to listen to your songs just a little longer. I want to teach Bench how to sing too, just like how Grandma taught me so many things.
speaker: Anita
content: I've never thought about it before, but now... Uh, I want to listen to your songs just a little longer. I want to teach Bench how to sing too, just like how Grandma taught me so many things.

raw: [name="Skadi"]In that case, you need to live as long as your grandmother.
speaker: Skadi
content: In that case, you need to live as long as your grandmother.

raw: [name="Anita"]Yep! At the very least, I'm not worried about anything right now.
speaker: Anita
content: Yep! At the very least, I'm not worried about anything right now.

raw: [name="Anita"]And that's because... Singer, you are still here. You will help us, and fight off these monsters, like, bam bam bam!
speaker: Anita
content: And that's because... Singer, you are still here. You will help us, and fight off these monsters, like, bam bam bam!

raw: [Subtitle(text="Gladiia has left.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Gladiia has left.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Skadi looks out at the sea.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Skadi looks out at the sea.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Unlike the dead silence of the day before, its waters are filled with living creatures. They cling onto each other and pile on top of one another. The creature at the very top stretches out its limb. It camouflages itself as a part of the sea waves, while striking the shore's reefs with each beating wave.", x=300, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Unlike the dead silence of the day before, its waters are filled with living creatures. They cling onto each other and pile on top of one another. The creature at the very top stretches out its limb. It camouflages itself as a part of the sea waves, while striking the shore's reefs with each beating wave.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Atop the hill, the chapel doors are wide open.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Atop the hill, the chapel doors are wide open.

raw: [Subtitle(text="The people ashore have already gone home.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The people ashore have already gone home.

raw: [Subtitle(text="The monsters of the sea, eyeless as they may be, merely 'stare' at the sight.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The monsters of the sea, eyeless as they may be, merely 'stare' at the sight.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=true)]

speaker: Skadi
content: My heartbeat... is getting faster.

raw: [Subtitle(text="It isn't just her heartbeat. She looks at her hands and sees something that only the eyes of a hunter can see. Unable to withstand the impact of her blood flow, her skin is trembling at a high speed.", x=300, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: It isn't just her heartbeat. She looks at her hands and sees something that only the eyes of a hunter can see. Unable to withstand the impact of her blood flow, her skin is trembling at a high speed.

raw: [Subtitle(text="The off-key singing reverberates in her eardrums, all while the odor of the sea irritates her nostrils.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The off-key singing reverberates in her eardrums, all while the odor of the sea irritates her nostrils.

speaker: Skadi
content: I see... Right.

speaker: Skadi
content: I am still a hunter...

raw: [Subtitle(text="A hunter chases her prey, and a hunter hunts her prey, but Abyssal Hunters dance atop the fangs and claws of their fallen prey. A hunter who has lost her partner is naturally lonely and despondent.", x=300, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: A hunter chases her prey, and a hunter hunts her prey, but Abyssal Hunters dance atop the fangs and claws of their fallen prey. A hunter who has lost her partner is naturally lonely and despondent.

raw: [Subtitle(text="She is a hunter herself, and not the kind after bounties. Running away any further would be meaningless. What she must do now is to turn around and join the hunt.", x=300, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: She is a hunter herself, and not the kind after bounties. Running away any further would be meaningless. What she must do now is to turn around and join the hunt.

raw: [Subtitle(text="They are the ones who should be afraid.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: They are the ones who should be afraid.

raw: [Subtitle(text="It is only now that Skadi has finally forgiven herself.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: It is only now that Skadi has finally forgiven herself.

raw: [Subtitle(text="She dashes toward the Sea Terror-filled tides.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: She dashes toward the Sea Terror-filled tides.

raw: [Subtitle(text="There is a stench. A stench lingers in the air of the chapel.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: There is a stench. A stench lingers in the air of the chapel.
